description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it and Decoction Module trigger.
Resolve the Decoction Module trigger, causing you to get {E}.
Resolve the Astral Dragon trigger, causing you to create two token copies of Decoction Module that are 3/3 Dragons in addition to their other types.
When the Decoction Module tokens enter the battlefield, each Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get six {E}.
Activate Whirler Virtuoso by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, each Decoction Module triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat from step 6.
